categories.main_business_segments: Yokorei Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two business segments: the refrigerated warehouse business and the food sales business. The refrigerated warehouse segment provides cold storage and related logistics services for marine, livestock, and agricultural products. The food sales segment is engaged in the processing, wholesale, import, and export of seafood, livestock, and agricultural products. The company also has a customs clearance business and a small real estate leasing segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include advanced cold storage and freezing technologies, with a focus on energy-efficient and environmentally friendly refrigeration systems. Operations emphasize the integration of traditional logistics expertise with digital innovations, such as smart cold chain services. In the food sales segment, the company leverages its global procurement network and product assessment capabilities to ensure quality and freshness. Manufacturing and logistics processes are supported by robust quality control and safety management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Yokorei serves a wide range of customers, including food manufacturers, wholesalers, retailers, and food service companies, primarily in the food industry. Its end markets are mainly in Japan but also extend to Asia and other international regions, focusing on the stable supply of safe and high-quality food products. The company does not have a single customer accounting for more than 10% of sales, indicating a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates an extensive network of refrigerated warehouses and logistics centers across Japan, with significant facilities in Hokkaido, Kanto, Chubu, Kansai, and Kyushu regions. Internationally, Yokorei has a presence in Thailand and Vietnam through subsidiaries and logistics centers, and it conducts business in other parts of Asia, North America, and Europe. The majority of sales and assets are concentrated in Japan, with growing operations in Southeast Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yokorei operates primarily in the midstream of the food supply chain, providing cold storage, logistics, and distribution services that connect upstream producers and processors with downstream wholesalers, retailers, and food service providers. In the food sales segment, the company acts as both a wholesaler and importer/exporter, bridging global producers and domestic/international buyers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic focus is on sustainable growth through the expansion of smart cold chain services, environmental initiatives (such as GHG reduction and natural refrigerant adoption), and global business development, particularly in ASEAN markets. Key themes include productivity improvement, digital transformation, and the development of environmentally friendly logistics centers. While there is no dedicated R&D department, innovation is pursued through operational improvements, facility upgrades, and sustainability-driven investments.
categories.revenue_model: Yokorei generates revenue primarily through service fees for cold storage, handling, and logistics in its warehouse segment, and through product sales in its food sales segment. The company also earns income from customs clearance services and real estate leasing. Revenue is recognized based on service delivery (storage/handling) or upon shipment and transfer of control for product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yokorei is one of Japan's leading cold storage and food logistics companies, competing with other major players such as Nichirei Logistics, Maruha Nichiro, and regional cold storage operators. In the food sales segment, it competes with large trading companies and specialized food wholesalers. The company differentiates itself through its extensive domestic and international logistics network, high-quality service, and commitment to sustainability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended September 2025, Yokorei reported consolidated net sales of 125.6 billion yen, with operating profit of 4.2 billion yen and net profit attributable to parent company shareholders of 2.0 billion yen. The company employs approximately 1,800 people on a consolidated basis. While sales have shown moderate growth, profitability has fluctuated due to cost pressures and market conditions. The company maintains a solid asset base and continues to invest in facility expansion and overseas growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yokorei emphasizes its ability to provide high-quality, reliable, and environmentally conscious cold chain logistics solutions, ensuring the stable supply of safe and fresh food products. Its value proposition includes a nationwide and international logistics network, advanced cold storage technology, and a strong focus on sustainability and compliance. The company also highlights its expertise in product sourcing and assessment, enabling it to deliver seasonal and high-value food products to customers.
